newsitem.title: EGYPT: Arafat in Cairo for Mideast talks with Mubarak.
newsitem.headline: Arafat in Cairo for Mideast talks with Mubarak.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat met Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak in Cairo on Sunday for talks on the stalled Middle East peace process, sources at the presidential palace said.
They said the two leaders held private talks at the Egyptian president's residence.
Arafat, who arrived in Cairo earlier, told reporters at the airport he was hopeful peace talks with Israel could be advanced.
"We face many difficulties in our talks with the Israeli side which is trying to avoid accurate and honest implementation of what has been agreed upon," he said.
"But we hope to succeed in achieving results to satisfy the Palestinian people and to preserve the peace process and push it forward," he added.
Arafat's visit coincided with an emergency meeting at the 22-member Arab League in the Egyptian capital over Israel's expansion of settlements on occupied Arab land.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has infuriated Arabs by refusing to trade occupied Arab lands for peace -- the basic principle of a 1991 Madrid peace conference -- and also by lifting a ban imposed by the former government on building Jewish settlements on these lands.
